ai_summary: The Anup Engineering Limited announced a Rs. 12/- per share final dividend for FY 2025-26, reflecting solid financial performance from its specialized heavy engineering business which generates nearly half its turnover from exports. However, significant red flags include a large portion of its workforce classified as "other than permanent" (783 out of 1174 total) and a rising permanent employee turnover rate of 20%, potentially impacting human capital and operational stability. Further, the company's 100% subsidiary is excluded from its business responsibility initiatives, indicating a gap in integrated sustainability governance.
